params.caption: 🎮 A GTA 6 supercar just rolled into the real world Rockstar Games has partnered with West Coast Customs to build a real-life version of an iconic Vice City supercar from GTA 6. Fans can actually buy it, with a reported price tag of around one million. Another sign the marketing push for GTA 6 is in full swing. 🕒 Nov 9, 2026 · 22:26 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto #GTA6 #Rockstar #GamingNews
